description: Source code for the Playwright Recorder Application, including the RecorderApp class, methods for initializing, event handling, and communication with the browser context, as well as a programmatic interface for automation.

classes.name: RecorderApp
classes.description: Main class managing the recorder UI, event handling, and communication with the browser context.

classes.name: ProgrammaticRecorderApp
classes.description: Provides a programmatic interface for recording actions without UI, emitting events for actions and signals.

methods.name: show
methods.description: Static method to display the recorder UI in a browser context, or run in API mode.

methods.name: showInspectorNoReply
methods.description: Shows the recorder inspector without waiting for a reply.

methods.name: _init
methods.description: Initializes the recorder app, sets up request interception, and loads the recorder UI.

methods.name: _createDispatcher
methods.description: Creates a dispatcher object to handle commands from the recorder frontend.

methods.name: _wireListeners
methods.description: Sets up event listeners for recorder events to update the frontend.

methods.name: _onActionAdded
methods.description: Handles new actions added to the recorder.

methods.name: _onSignalAdded
methods.description: Handles new signals added to the recorder.

methods.name: _onUserSourcesChanged
methods.description: Updates sources when user sources change.

methods.name: _pushAllSources
methods.description: Pushes all sources to the frontend.

methods.name: _revealSource
methods.description: Requests frontend to reveal a specific source.

methods.name: _updateActions
methods.description: Generates code from actions, updates sources, and manages source reveal.
